messages:
Anya (PM): Quick planning thread 11 we need to pick a path for enterprise evidence for ArborCare + NovaHealth pilots. Scope asks: BYOK/KMS handshake, signed export bundles, retention lanes (incl. 7y), on-demand export SLA, SOC2/ISO attachments. Target: pilot-ready in 6 weeks. Opinions?
Jorge (Eng): Short: doable, but two big risks: (1) storage+egress cost for 7y cold archives, (2) export runtime for large tenants. We should estimate monthly OPEX and a best-effort <4h export SLI for initial pilot.
Maya (Security): BYOK must support HSM-backed keys or at least KMS with strong IAM bindings. No default key escrow unless customer signs opt-in. For exports, require signed manifest with SHA256 of each snapshot file and a signed statement of processing steps. Also need replay protection on export tokens.
Sofia (Legal): Manifest + chain-of-custody language is mandatory for regulated customers. We also need a retention exception API for legal holds and subpoena responses. I'll draft minimal contract addendum and "we won't escrow customer keys" clause for review.
Liam (Sales): Customers will pay for storage but want predictable pricing. Ask: can we offer a retention add-on (per-GB/mo) plus an export SLA tier? ArborCare wants SOC2 attachments included; NovaHealth needs 7y retention and BYOK in their VPC.
Anya (PM): Propose roadmap options:
- Option Alpha (fast): BYOK handshake + exported signed snapshots + retention lanes (30d, 1yr, 7yr). Export is asynchronous with queue; SLA best-effort <4h.
- Option Beta (comprehensive): add streaming verbatim audit, export compression, export priority tiers (gold/silver/bronze), and on-demand <2h SLA.
Which do we pick for pilot?
Jorge (Eng): Alpha preferred for speed. Implementation notes: use existing snapshotter, add per-tenant encryption-context, and a background exporter that assembles JSONL bundles and a manifest. Need schema signoff for JSONL fields. We'll need a job to rewrap keys during rotation with zero downtime.
Maya (Security): Alpha + a few hard constraints: require KMS key identifiers be bound to tenant, signed manifests use customer's JWK, and sampling defaults: control-plane 100%, content 5% (opt-in to 100%). Must document forensic caveats if sampling is used.
Sofia (Legal): For Alpha acceptability: manifest + export audit trail + retention exception API. Also need explicit language around export certification and a standard affidavit template. If we can provide that, Legal can greenlight pilot contracts.
Anya (PM): Example minimal JSONL export row (for schema review):
```json
{"ts":"2025-10-12T17:23:11Z","tenant":"arborcare-prod","event":"completion","model":"redwood-rl1","request_id":"r_9a19","user_id_hash":"sha256:...","meta":{"route":"/v1/generate","tokens":54},"content_preview":"[redacted]","forensic_refs":["file://snapshots/arborcare/20251012/part-0001.jsonl.gz"]}
```
Maya (Security): content_preview must be redacted by default. Add a `content_hash` for integrity and a `redaction_policy` tag.
Jorge (Eng): We'll include gzip chunks and manifest entries like `part-0001.jsonl.gz.sha256`. Export worker will stream from object store into archive, sign manifest with customer key or our HSM if customer opts out.
ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-5109: "Enterprise evidence pilot: ArborCare/NovaHealth" assigned to Jorge (Eng). ETA 6 weeks.
Liam (Sales): I'll consolidate customer asks and send a pricing request to Finance. Also flag any customers that need on-prem agent for evidence export.
Sofia (Legal): I'll post a draft addendum by Tue EOD. If we cant deliver signed manifest with customer key, note alternative verbiage for certification.
Anya (PM): Action items: Jorge 1 prototype exporter + cost estimate (Fri), Maya 1 security checklist + KMS integration doc (Wed), Sofia 1 contract addendum draft (Tue), Liam 1 customer confirmation & pricing needs (Mon). Reconvene next Tue 10am PT. :calendar: :robot_face:
